title: Single-Use Plastic Count
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=foodwaste:log event=packaging
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(single_use_items) as plastics by _time
| eventstats avg(plastics) as base
| eval improving=if(plastics<base,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Counts the single-use plastic items entering your home each week, making an invisible habit visible.
value: You cannot cut what you cannot see; a weekly plastic count is the first step to meaningful reduction.
implementation: Log single-use items into `index=personal`; trend the weekly count.
visualization: Column chart of weekly single-use plastic count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts the single-use plastics coming into your home each week, so you can cut them down.
